historicalFindings.headline: VIX is historically elevated
historicalFindings.explanation: VIX has percentile rank 88.9 among 1290 available dated observations from 2021-11-22 to 2026-11-24; this suggests more caution than the history median.

historicalFindings.headline: High-yield credit spread is historically elevated
historicalFindings.explanation: High-yield credit spread has percentile rank 92.6 among 810 available dated observations from 2023-10-23 to 2026-11-24; this suggests more caution than the history median.

historicalFindings.headline: Investment-grade credit spread is historically elevated
historicalFindings.explanation: Investment-grade credit spread has percentile rank 83.2 among 809 available dated observations from 2023-10-23 to 2026-11-24; this suggests more caution than the history median.

historicalFindings.headline: Equal-weight market breadth is historically elevated
historicalFindings.explanation: Equal-weight market breadth has percentile rank 99.2 among 1258 available dated observations from 2021-11-22 to 2026-11-25; this suggests supportive participation relative to its history.

divergences: High-yield spreads remain below the absolute 400 bp watch threshold, but have percentile rank 92.6 among observations from 2023-10-23 to 2026-11-24. The level looks contained, but its historical position merits monitoring.
Broad equal-weight outperformance is unusual in the observed sample; this is supportive participation, not evidence by itself of lower future volatility.

keyFindings.headline: Equity-implied volatility is elevated
keyFindings.explanation: VIX exceeds the stated watch threshold; this is not a forecast of future returns.

keyFindings.headline: Equal-weight participation is supportive
keyFindings.explanation: Equal-weight equities have outperformed the cap-weighted benchmark over the measurement window.

keyFindings.headline: Corporate credit spreads remain contained
keyFindings.explanation: Both investment-grade and high-yield spreads are below the defined watch thresholds.

whatWouldChangeTheView: Watch for sustained high-yield spread widening, not just a one-day move.
Compare equal-weight participation with headline index moves and credit pricing.
methodology: Transparent illustrative rules, not a calibrated prediction or investment advice.
limitations: Scores and thresholds are provisional and require historical validation.
Credit-stress and recession composite scores are excluded from independent evidence counts.
No conclusions about causality are inferred from coincident indicator movements.
Input card values are snapshot-level, not necessarily underlying observation publication dates.
Historical percentiles use only the actual stored date range and may be shorter than five years.

High-yield spreads remain below the absolute 400 bp watch threshold, but have percentile rank 92.6 among observations from 2023-10-23 to 2026-11-24. The level looks contained, but its historical position merits monitoring.
